cases.precondition: Load a save created before cqa001 was ever installed.
cases.expected: First Signal and Wait for the signal. activate once without a manual trigger.

cases.precondition: Measure wall-clock time from objective activation without pausing the game.
cases.expected: The objective does not succeed before ten real-time seconds and then advances once.

cases.precondition: Let the first-run path finish without interruption.
cases.expected: The objective and quest both show succeeded state, and no localization key is blank.

cases.precondition: Save while the delay is active, reload that save, and record whether elapsed time resumes or restarts.
cases.expected: Reloading neither duplicates journal activation nor blocks completion; timer behavior is recorded explicitly.

cases.precondition: Save after completion and reload without changing the installation.
cases.expected: The cqa001_completed guard takes the false route and the quest does not reactivate.

cases.precondition: Remove and reinstall the identical candidate, then load the completed save.
cases.expected: The quest remains completed and does not create a second activation.

cases.precondition: Reload the original untouched pre-install save with the identical candidate still installed.
cases.expected: The first-run route activates and completes once with the same player-facing result.

cases.precondition: Retain fresh RED4ext and ArchiveXL logs from the clean-save run.
cases.expected: The logs contain no cqa001 registration, depot-path, journal, or localization lookup error.

promotion_rule: Set status to passed and evidence_class to runtime-proven only when every required case passes and the run binds both installed payloads, the pre-install save, exact versions, and all four retained logs to hashes.
